# ScopeSite Digital Studios
> Veteran-owned AI-first web design agency in Somerset, UK. We build server-side rendered websites optimised for Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews using the V.O.I.C.E™ methodology.

## Core Services
- [AI-First Web Design](https://scopesite.co.uk/ai-website-design): Websites built to be recommended by AI platforms, not just indexed by Google.
- [V.O.I.C.E™ Methodology](https://scopesite.co.uk/voice): Proprietary framework for AI search visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini.
- [AI SEO Services](https://scopesite.co.uk/ai-seo-services): AI search optimisation that gets businesses recommended by AI platforms.
- [Web Design](https://scopesite.co.uk/web-design): Server-side rendered websites with full schema markup and Core Web Vitals optimisation.
- [Schema Markup](https://scopesite.co.uk/schema-markup): JSON-LD structured data implementation for rich results and AI visibility.
- [Pricing](https://scopesite.co.uk/pricing): Transparent pricing for all services.
